remarks: Prime Commercial Opportunity on a High-Traffic Main Road!  Don't miss this beautifully updated commercial building offering outstanding visibility and versatility.  Featuring brand-new flooring and thoughtful renovations, this property boasts a spacious open-concept layout perfect for a variety of business uses.  Warm and inviting pine walls add rustic charm, while a stunning large stone fireplace creates a unique focal point your customers will remember.  The property is also equipped with a new cooler and new ice machine.  Upstairs, you'll find a well-appointed two bedroom apartment with an additional bonus room, offering excellent potential for own-occupancy, rental income, or on-site management.  Whether you're starting a new venture or expanding your portfolio, this property combines character, functionality, and income potential in a prime location.  Listing is also listed commercially as R1666849.
